My scratchwork for task 2

(NOTE: I started this before I realized task 2 was done by someone else. I am leaving this code here for reference.)

Notes:

* In my analysis used stratified sampling (line 32)
* included lemmatization
* Line 112 filtered for words that appear in more than 5 documents, can change it later

```{r load and split}
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
library(rsample)

# Load in task 1 cleaned data, simple data checks
load("../../data/claims-clean-task1.RData")

task2 <- claims_clean2
colnames(task2)
unique(task2$bclass)
class(task2$bclass)

# Split into train and test set
set.seed(101422)
claims_split <- initial_split(
  task2,
  prop = 0.8,
  strata = bclass
)

claims_train <- training(claims_split)
claims_test <- testing(claims_split)

# Check the sizes and class balance.
bind_rows(
  claims_train %>% count(bclass) %>% mutate(dataset = "Training"),
  claims_test %>% count(bclass) %>% mutate(dataset = "Test")
) %>%
  select(dataset, everything())
```

```{r word features}
# Load preprocessing code
source("../preprocessing.R")

word_counts_fn <- function(.df) {
  .df |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    select(.id, text_clean) |> 
    
    # Split text into words and remove stopwords
    unnest_tokens(
      output = token,
      input = text_clean,
      token = "words",
      stopwords = str_remove_all(
        tidytext::stop_words$word,
        "[[:punct:]]"
      )
    ) |> 
    
    # Convert related word forms to their dictionary form
    mutate(token.lem = textstem::lemmatize_words(token)) |> 
    filter(str_length(token.lem) > 2) |> 
    
    # Count each word within each webpage
    count(.id, token.lem, name = "n")
}

word_counts_train <- word_counts_fn(claims_train)
word_counts_test <- word_counts_fn(claims_test)
```

```{r word checks}
word_counts_train |> slice_head(n = 10)

# Summarize tokenization.
tibble(
  dataset = c("Training", "Test"),
  pages_with_words = c(
    n_distinct(word_counts_train$.id),
    n_distinct(word_counts_test$.id)
  ),
  distinct_words = c(
    n_distinct(word_counts_train$token.lem),
    n_distinct(word_counts_test$token.lem)
  )
)

# Identify pages that lost all words during filtering.
empty_word_pages_train <- claims_train %>%
  anti_join(word_counts_train %>% distinct(.id), by = ".id")

empty_word_pages_test <- claims_test %>%
  anti_join(word_counts_test %>% distinct(.id), by = ".id")

c(
  training_pages_without_words = nrow(empty_word_pages_train),
  test_pages_without_words = nrow(empty_word_pages_test)
)
```

```{r learn vocab}
library(Matrix)

word_vocab <- word_counts_train |> 
  distinct(.id, token.lem) |> 
  count(token.lem, name = "document_frequency") |> 
#  filter(document_frequency >= 5) |> # retain words found in at least 5 pages to make PCA more manageable
  arrange(token.lem) |> 
  mutate(
    idf = log(nrow(claims_train) / document_frequency)
  )

nrow(word_vocab)
```

```{r TF-IDF matrix}
make_word_tfidf <- function(counts, page_ids, vocabulary){
  
  weighted_counts <- counts |> 
    group_by(.id) |> 
    mutate(tf = n / sum(n)) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    inner_join(
      vocabulary |> select(token.lem, idf),
      by = "token.lem"
    ) |> 
    mutate(tf_idf = tf * idf)
  
  # Rows are page ids, columns are training vocab
  Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = match(weighted_counts$.id, page_ids),
    j = match(weighted_counts$token.lem, vocabulary$token.lem),
    x = weighted_counts$tf_idf,
    dims = c(length(page_ids), nrow(vocabulary)),
    dimnames = list(page_ids, vocabulary$token.lem)
  )
}

word_x_train <- make_word_tfidf(
  counts = word_counts_train,
  page_ids = claims_train$.id,
  vocabulary = word_vocab
)

word_x_test <- make_word_tfidf(
  counts = word_counts_test,
  page_ids = claims_test$.id,
  vocabulary = word_vocab
)

tibble(
  dataset = c("Training", "Test"),
  webpages = c(nrow(word_x_train), nrow(word_x_test)),
  word_features = c(ncol(word_x_train), ncol(word_x_test)),
  zero_feature_pages = c(
    sum(Matrix::rowSums(word_x_train) == 0),
    sum(Matrix::rowSums(word_x_test) == 0)
  )
)

# Preview a small section without printing the full matrix.
as.matrix(word_x_train[1:5, 1:min(6, ncol(word_x_train))])
```

```{r activity projection functions}

# path to activity files on repo

source(paste(url, 'projection-functions.R', sep = ''))
```

```{r project datasets}
word_proj_out <- projection_fn(
  .dtm = word_x_train,
  .prop = 0.8
)

word_train_projected <- word_proj_out$data

word_test_projected <- reproject_fn(
  .dtm = word_x_test,
  .projection_fn_out = word_proj_out
)

dim(word_train_projected)
dim(word_test_projected)
```

```{r word-only logistic regression}
word_train_model <- claims_train |> 
  select(bclass) |> 
  bind_cols(word_train_projected)

word_fit <- glm(
  bclass ~ .,
  data = word_train_model,
  family = binomial()
)

# Check fitting results
tibble(
  converged = word_fit$converged,
  iterations = word_fit$iter,
  estimated_rank = word_fit$rank,
  coefficients_including_intercept = length(coef(word_fit)),
  missing_coefficients = sum(is.na(coef(word_fit)))
)
```
